create_JobsRegistry: create a JobsRegistry instance to store and manage scheduled jobs in an ordered dictionary
register_job: register a StopesJob into the JobsRegistry so it can be tracked and queried later
kill_job: kill a running or pending job by its ID using the async kill_job method
segment_registry_by_status: segment all jobs in the registry by their current status like COMPLETED or FAILED
get_log_for_registry_jobs_ordered_by_sta: get a formatted log string of all registry jobs grouped by their status
